1) we propose a robust framework to explore the dependencies among attributes in high-dimensional data and construct a dependency graph; 2) we propose a novel method for differentially private data publication by identifying the marginal tables that approximate the joint distribution of data; 3) we prove that selecting the marginals with the minimum error is NP-hard; and 4) we design an approximation algorithm for the problem.
